mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of the federal funds rate compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5% annualized and monthly inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, the combination signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annualized and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annualized and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, high housing starts (HOUST) signal overbuilding and potential market saturation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, the combination signals a tight labor market that fuels inflation and prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales exceeding 0.8% signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS rises > 0.8% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, higher federal funds rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%.
